name: Falcon Heavy | USSF-63
description:
Classified payload for the US Space Force.

This launch will also carry the Oracle-M, a cutting-edge SSA pathfinder satellite designed to provide persistent situational awareness in cis-lunar space, demonstrating new tracking and navigation capabilities essential for future space operations. The mission will showcase tracking and trajectory estimation for monitoring cis-lunar objects, cloud-based ground operations with integrated government and contractor collaboration, and navigation and communications using affordable commercial ground systems. It will also support data collection and distribution to those charged with maintaining cis-lunar situational awareness.
